methodology.weekly_binding: latest weekly replay state with as_of <= daily date
methodology.monthly_binding: latest monthly replay state with as_of <= daily date
methodology.non_overlap: deterministic per-symbol spacing >= outcome horizon on SPY trading-session index
methodology.incremental_edge: confluence thesis-aligned mean minus strongest same-year component direction-family baseline
methodology.full_year_support: at least 2 full years and every evaluated full year passes; partial year supporting only
